001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.raid;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.raid.RaidIntel.RaidStageStatus;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
008
009public class ReturnStage extends BaseRaidStage {
010
011        public ReturnStage(RaidIntel raid) {
012                super(raid);
013        }
014
015        @Override
016        public void notifyStarted() {
017                updateRoutes();
018        }
019
020        @Override
021        public void advance(float amount) {
022                super.advance(amount);
023        }
024
025        protected void updateRoutes() {
026                giveReturnOrdersToStragglers(getRoutes());
027                maxDays = 3f;
028                //intel.setExtraDays(0f);
029        }
030        
031        protected void updateStatus() {
032                status = RaidStageStatus.SUCCESS;
033        }
034        
035        public void showStageInfo(TooltipMakerAPI info) {
036                int curr = intel.getCurrentStage();
037                int index = intel.getStageIndex(this);
038                
039                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
040                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
041                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
042                float pad = 3f;
043                float opad = 10f;
044                
045                if (curr >= index) {
046                        info.addPara("The raid is over, and the fleets involved are returning to their home bases.", opad);
047                }
048        }
049}
